audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Jethro, Zipporah and sons, testimony of deliverance, meal before Divine, delegation of judges, and sustainable leadership.

verses.restored: Jethro, priest of Midian, father-in-law of Moses, heard all that Divine had done for Moses and for Israel his people, that YHWH brought Israel out from Egypt.

familiar.text: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

modern.text: Now Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about all that God had done for Moses and His people Israel, and how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֞ע יִתְר֨וֹ כֹהֵ֤ן מִדְיָן֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְמֹשֶׁ֔ה וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּ֑וֹ כִּֽי הוֹצִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took Zipporah, wife of Moses, after her sending away,

familiar.text: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,

modern.text: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro had received her,

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֗ח יִתְרוֹ֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת צִפֹּרָ֖ה אֵ֣שֶׁת מֹשֶׁ֑ה אַחַ֖ר שִׁלּוּחֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: and her two sons, one whose name was Gershom, for he said, I have been a sojourner in foreign land,

familiar.text: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

modern.text: along with her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses had said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”

original.text: וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֣י בָנֶ֑יהָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שֵׁ֤ם הָֽאֶחָד֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר גֵּ֣ר הָיִ֔יתִי בְּאֶ֖רֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה

verses.restored: and name of the other was Eliezer, for Divine of my father was my help and rescued me from sword of Pharaoh.

familiar.text: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

modern.text: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, “The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.”

original.text: וְשֵׁ֥ם הָאֶחָ֖ד אֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר כִּֽי אֱלֹהֵ֤י אָבִי֙ בְּעֶזְרִ֔י וַיַּצִּלֵ֖נִי מֵחֶ֥רֶב פַּרְעֹֽה

verses.restored: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, and his sons and his wife came to Moses, to wilderness where he was camping at mountain of Divine.

familiar.text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

modern.text: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, along with Moses’ wife and sons, came to him in the desert, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֞א יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה וּבָנָ֥יו וְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֶל הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר אֲשֶׁר ה֛וּא חֹנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: He said to Moses, I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you, and your wife and her two sons with her.

familiar.text: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

modern.text: He sent word to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲנִ֛י חֹתֶנְךָ֥ יִתְר֖וֹ בָּ֣א אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְאִ֨שְׁתְּךָ֔ וּשְׁנֵ֥י בָנֶ֖יהָ עִמָּֽהּ

verses.restored: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, bowed, and kissed him; each asked his companion of peace, and they came into the tent.

familiar.text: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

modern.text: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.

original.text: וַיֵּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִקְרַ֣את חֹֽתְנ֗וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ וַיִּשַּׁק ל֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֥וּ אִישׁ לְרֵעֵ֖הוּ לְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ הָאֹֽהֱלָה

verses.restored: Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that YHWH had done to Pharaoh and Egypt on account of Israel, all hardship that had found them on the way, and how YHWH rescued them.

familiar.text: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

modern.text: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships they had encountered along the way, and how the LORD had delivered them.

original.text: וַיְסַפֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ לְחֹ֣תְנ֔וֹ אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְפַרְעֹ֣ה וּלְמִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֤ת כָּל הַתְּלָאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְצָאָ֣תַם בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וַיַּצִּלֵ֖ם יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Jethro rejoiced over all the good that YHWH had done to Israel, whom he rescued from hand of Egypt.

familiar.text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

modern.text: And Jethro rejoiced over all the good things the LORD had done for Israel, whom He had rescued from the hand of the Egyptians.

original.text: וַיִּ֣חַדְּ יִתְר֔וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצִּיל֖וֹ מִיַּ֥ד מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Jethro said, Blessed be YHWH, who rescued you from hand of Egypt and from hand of Pharaoh, who rescued the people from under hand of Egypt.

familiar.text: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

modern.text: Jethro declared, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from the hand of the Egyptians.

original.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ יִתְרוֹ֒ בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִיַּ֥ד מִצְרַ֖יִם וּמִיַּ֣ד פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִצִּיל֙ אֶת הָעָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת יַד מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Now I know that YHWH is greater than all gods, because in the matter in which they acted arrogantly against them.

familiar.text: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

modern.text: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”

original.text: עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי גָד֥וֹל יְהוָ֖ה מִכָּל הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י בַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָד֖וּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took burnt offering and sacrifices for Divine; Aaron came and all elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before the Divine.

familiar.text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God.

modern.text: Then Moses’ father-in-law Jethro brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God. Jethro Advises Moses (Deuteronomy 1:9–18)

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה עֹלָ֥ה וּזְבָחִ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכֹ֣ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֶאֱכָל לֶ֛חֶם עִם חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: It happened next day Moses sat to judge the people, and people stood around Moses from morning until evening.

familiar.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

modern.text: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people, and they stood around him from morning until evening.

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶת הָעָ֑ם וַיַּעֲמֹ֤ד הָעָם֙ עַל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן הַבֹּ֖קֶר עַד הָעָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Moses' father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the people and said, What is this thing you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning until evening?

familiar.text: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

modern.text: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he asked, “What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone as judge, with all the people standing around you from morning till evening?”

original.text: וַיַּרְא֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה לָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹשֶׂה֙ לָעָ֔ם מַדּ֗וּעַ אַתָּ֤ה יוֹשֵׁב֙ לְבַדֶּ֔ךָ וְכָל הָעָ֛ם נִצָּ֥ב עָלֶ֖יךָ מִן בֹּ֥קֶר עַד עָֽרֶב

verses.restored: Moses said to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to inquire of Divine.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:

modern.text: “Because the people come to me to inquire of God,” Moses replied.

original.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְחֹתְנ֑וֹ כִּֽי יָבֹ֥א אֵלַ֛י הָעָ֖ם לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: When they have a matter, it comes to me, and I judge between a man and his companion, and I make known statutes of the Divine and his Torah/instructions.

familiar.text: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

modern.text: “Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me to judge between one man and another, and I make known to them the statutes and laws of God.”

original.text: כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם דָּבָר֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י וְשָׁ֣פַטְתִּ֔י בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּבֵ֣ין רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְהוֹדַעְתִּ֛י אֶת חֻקֵּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאֶת תּוֹרֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: Moses' father-in-law said to him, The thing you are doing is not good.

familiar.text: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

modern.text: But Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good.

original.text: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֵלָ֑יו לֹא טוֹב֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: Fading, you will fade away, both you and this people with you, for the matter is too heavy for you; you are not able to do it alone.

familiar.text: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

modern.text: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.

original.text: נָבֹ֣ל תִּבֹּ֔ל גַּם אַתָּ֕ה גַּם הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי כָבֵ֤ד מִמְּךָ֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר לֹא תוּכַ֥ל עֲשֹׂ֖הוּ לְבַדֶּֽךָ

verses.restored: Now listen to my voice; I will counsel you, and may Divine be with you. You be for the people before the Divine, and bring the matters to the Divine.

familiar.text: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

modern.text: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.

original.text: עַתָּ֞ה שְׁמַ֤ע בְּקֹלִי֙ אִיעָ֣צְךָ֔ וִיהִ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּ֑ךְ הֱיֵ֧ה אַתָּ֣ה לָעָ֗ם מ֚וּל הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ אַתָּ֛ה אֶת הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֶל הָאֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: You shall warn them with statutes and Torah/instructions, and make known to them the way they shall walk and the work they shall do.

familiar.text: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

modern.text: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.

original.text: וְהִזְהַרְתָּ֣ה אֶתְהֶ֔ם אֶת הַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת הַתּוֹרֹ֑ת וְהוֹדַעְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֗ם אֶת הַדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔הּ וְאֶת הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֽׂוּן

verses.restored: But you shall see from all the people capable men, fearing/revering Divine, men of truth, hating unjust gain, and set them over them as chiefs of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.

familiar.text: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

modern.text: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה תֶחֱזֶ֣ה מִכָּל הָ֠עָם אַנְשֵׁי חַ֜יִל יִרְאֵ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י אֱמֶ֖ת שֹׂ֣נְאֵי בָ֑צַע וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ עֲלֵהֶ֗ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת

verses.restored: They shall judge the people at every time; every great matter they shall bring to you, and every small matter they shall judge themselves. Make it lighter from upon you, and they shall bear with you.

familiar.text: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

modern.text: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.

original.text: וְשָׁפְט֣וּ אֶת הָעָם֮ בְּכָל עֵת֒ וְהָיָ֞ה כָּל הַדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדֹל֙ יָבִ֣יאוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְכָל הַדָּבָ֥ר הַקָּטֹ֖ן יִשְׁפְּטוּ הֵ֑ם וְהָקֵל֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְנָשְׂא֖וּ אִתָּֽךְ

verses.restored: If you do this thing, and Divine commands you, then you will be able to stand, and also all this people will go to their place in peace.

familiar.text: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

modern.text: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”

original.text: אִ֣ם אֶת הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְצִוְּךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְיָֽכָלְתָּ֖ עֲמֹ֑ד וְגַם֙ כָּל הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל מְקֹמ֖וֹ יָבֹ֥א בְשָׁלֽוֹם

verses.restored: Moses listened to voice of his father-in-law and did all that he said.

familiar.text: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

modern.text: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְק֣וֹל חֹתְנ֑וֹ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמָֽר

verses.restored: Moses chose capable men from all Israel and gave them as heads over the people, chiefs of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.

familiar.text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

modern.text: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.

original.text: וַיִּבְחַ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֤ה אַנְשֵׁי חַ֨יִל֙ מִכָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עַל הָעָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת

verses.restored: They judged the people at every time; hard matter they brought to Moses, and every small matter they judged themselves.

familiar.text: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

modern.text: And they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult cases to Moses, but any minor issue they would judge themselves.

verses.restored: Moses sent his father-in-law away, and he went to his land.

familiar.text: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

modern.text: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own land.

original.text: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת חֹתְנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ ל֖וֹ אֶל אַרְצֽוֹ

translation_notes: Jethro is Midianite priest and gives true wisdom; preserve non-Israelite wisdom and hospitality.
Leadership sustainability is explicit: 'not good,' too heavy, you cannot do it alone.
Delegation requires capable, truth-grounded people who hate unjust gain.
Zipporah and sons re-enter the narrative; do not erase them.
safety_note: Exodus 18 supports distributed leadership, not charismatic bottlenecking. It is a major anti-burnout and anti-domination text.
